reason: A is the better proposal because it advances a new, falsifiable thermomechanical intervention for refractory HEAs at 1200–1600°C, whereas B essentially repeats the intervention, conditions, mechanism, and outcomes already demonstrated in the cited 650°C study. A remains high-risk because a 2100°C anneal may erase pre-strain defects and the nominally precipitate-free HfMoNbTaW baseline offers no clear source for coherent reprecipitation, but it is nevertheless the more substantive research hypothesis.
